1.consolidated_definition: Se dice de la persona de aspecto enfermizo, enclenque. “La verdad es que lo de Ripken es una hazaña, especialmente en estos tiempos en que los peloteros parecen criados con leche pedía, como decían en el barrio cuando alguien era débil o flojo.” Elliot Castro Tirado, “Los canto como los veo”, Claridad, 15 al 21 de septiembre de 1995.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This refers to a person with an emaciated or frail appearance. "The truth is that Ripken's feat is an achievement, especially in these times when baseball players seem to be raised on milk, as they used to say in the neighborhood when someone was weak or lazy." Elliot Castro Tirado, "Los canto como los veo", Claridad, 15-21 September 1995.

Translation:
This refers to a person with an emaciated or frail appearance. The term is often used to describe someone who appears weak or feeble.
